summary: Full-stack testing of 3 new features (Discount/Voucher, Split Payment, Bluetooth print button) plus regression. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASS including 4 new voucher tests, discount+voucher persistence, split transaction persistence, and shift report totals (verified total_cash=13000, total_qris=7000, total_revenue=20000 with mixed cash/qris/split txns). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Cart 'Diskon & Voucher' section renders; KEBAB10 voucher applies green pill 'Voucher KEBAB10 · -Rp1.500'; manual discount input applies 'Diskon manual aktif: -Rp2.000'; cart shows Subtotal/Diskon/Total lines correctly. Checkout modal shows 3 payment buttons (Tunai/QRIS/Split); Split reveals Bagian Tunai input + 3 preset buttons; split checkout creates receipt with Tunai + QRIS lines. Receipt has 'Cetak via Bluetooth' button which shows 'Bluetooth tidak tersedia di web' status when pressed on Expo Go/web. /printer-settings screen reachable from cashier & admin headers and displays 'Fitur Bluetooth hanya bekerja pada build native' info warning. Admin Riwayat > detail modal displays Subtotal/Diskon rows and Tunai+QRIS breakdown for split txn with 'Cetak Ulang via Bluetooth' button. All acceptance criteria in the review request are met.

ui_bugs.issue: Voucher error <Text> at line 613 lacks a testID (state var 'voucherErr' rendered but not test-addressable). Minor - visual error still renders red inline.
Transaction row summary displays only 'QRIS' (or 'Tunai') label for a split payment method — no 'Split' indicator on list summary. Detail modal is correct. Minor cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID='voucher-error' to the inline voucher error Text in cashier.tsx (line 613) for easier automated verification of invalid voucher UX.
(Optional) Display payment method label 'Split' (or 'Tunai+QRIS') on admin history list row when payment_method === 'split'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~500 lines and still readable; consider splitting routes into modules if it grows further.
printer.ts base64 encoder is hand-rolled — acceptable for controlled bytes, but consider using btoa/Buffer wrapper for robustness.
Vouchers are hardcoded in VOUCHERS dict — if promotions expand, move to Mongo collection with admin CRUD.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (voucher apply/clear, manual discount, split payment checkout, receipt, BT button, printer-settings screen, admin history detail)

seed_data_creation: Created a shift with fresh cashier_id 'TEST_report_<pid>' and 3 test transactions (cash 10000 + qris 5000 + split 3000/2000) to verify shift report totals. Also a discount+voucher cash txn on top. These use TEST_ prefixed product_name for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_kebab_pos.py now has 23 tests (auth, catalog CRUD, shifts, txns, dashboard, vouchers, new features). Voucher codes seeded in-memory in server.py: KEBAB10 (10%), HEMAT20 (20%), PROMO5 (5%). Split payment stored via cash_amount+qris_amount fields; shift_report aggregates them correctly. Bluetooth is web-safe: printer.ts gracefully handles missing native module, returns 'Bluetooth tidak tersedia di web' — testable on preview URL without crashing.
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature verification only. No bugs blocking release.
